blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-accessibility-1 (Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-accessibility-2 (Icon-only delete control has no accessible name) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Render the delete action as a native `<button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={onDelete}>`. As a `div` it has no `tabindex`, no role and no key handler: a keyboard user pressing Tab never lands on it, and Enter or Space cannot trigger it, so they cannot delete a document — the very task the change adds (WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value). Screen reader users do not hear it announced as a button either. The native element gives focus, role and Enter/Space activation together; check that the `icon-button` style keeps a visible focus indicator (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
findings.title: Delete action is a clickable div, unreachable by keyboard

findings.recommendation: Give the control a text name, e.g. `aria-label="Delete document"` on the button (or visually hidden text inside it). Its only content is `TrashIcon`, whose `<svg>` is `aria-hidden="true"` (src/components/icons.tsx:3), so even once it becomes a `<button>` a screen reader user reaching it hears only "button", with nothing saying it deletes the document — they cannot identify the action before triggering a destructive operation (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content, 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value).
findings.title: Icon-only delete control has no accessible name

findings.recommendation: Add a text alternative. The proposal says the toolbar "shows the owner's avatar", so the image conveys who owns the document: pass the owner's name in and render `alt={`${ownerName}'s avatar`}` (or `alt={ownerName}`). If the owner's name is already shown as text next to it, use `alt=""` instead. Without any `alt`, screen readers announce the image file name or URL from `avatarUrl`, or "image", and the owner is never conveyed (WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content).
findings.title: Owner avatar image has no alt attribute

findings.recommendation: The `icon-button` class is styled outside the change (no stylesheet in the repository diff), and the only visible size is the 16×16 `TrashIcon`. Check that the control's hit area is at least 24×24 CSS pixels or has enough spacing (WCAG 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)), that the icon stroke meets 3:1 against the toolbar background (WCAG 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast), and that it shows a visible focus once it is a button (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible).
findings.title: Delete target size and focus style not verifiable in the change
